'''Roll-On''' was the name given to the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] used by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] as of [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. He was present when Antilles assisted during a hasty [[Mission to save Kessel|operation]] to prevent the destruction of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].

Partway through the mission, Wedge lent control of his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] and Roll-On to [[Rhysati Ynr]] who, in turn, let Antilles borrow her [[Eta-5 interceptor]].
